name: churn_break_even
note: Invented practice case: break-even save rate at a fictional mobile operator. KNOWN FAILURE on qwen3.6:35b as of 2026-09-22.

request.question: What save rate among accepting churners would the campaign need in order to break even?
stated_figures: Me: The operator has 4 million postpaid subscribers.
Me: Each subscriber generates $25 of contribution margin per month.
Me: A customer who is saved from churning stays for an average of 18 more months.
Me: The campaign targets the top 10% by churn risk, which is 400,000 customers.
Me: That top 10% contains 45% of all customers who would churn that month.
Me: The retention offer is a discount worth $60 in total for each customer who accepts it.
Me: 50% of targeted customers accept the offer, whether or not they were going to churn.
Me: Among the churners who accept 30% are actually saved.

must_match: impossible|cannot break even|can't break even|not achievable|above 100|over 100|exceeds 100|19[0-9] ?(%|percent)
